summary_en: Decree 'De variatione inducenda in n. 5 Normarum universalium de anno liturgico et de calendario': solemnities occurring on the Sundays of Advent, Lent and Easter are no longer anticipated to the Saturday but transferred to the following Monday (or to the Monday after the Second Sunday of Easter when the occurrence is on Palm Sunday or Easter Sunday); particular calendars already prepared for 1991 may keep the previous solution. Norm to be observed by all henceforth.
excerpt:
« Propter suum peculiare momentum, dominica suam cedit celebrationem solummodo sollemnitatibus necnon festis Domini; dominicæ vero Adventus, Quadragesimæ et Paschæ super omnia festa Domini et super omnes sollemnitates præcedentiam habent. Sollemnitates autem in his dominicis occurrentes ad feriam secundam sequentem transferuntur, nisi agatur de occurrentia in Dominica in Palmis aut in Dominica Resurrectionis Domini ».
Ex ædibus Congregationis de Cultu Divino et Disciplina Sacramentorum, die 22 aprilis 1990, Dominica II Paschæ « in albis ».

summary_en: St Melchior García Sampedro, bishop, is confirmed as patron of the missionaries and of all engaged in the missionary apostolate of the archdiocese of Oviedo (Spain); a patron of a category of persons. The protocol is printed without a year suffix ('Prot. CD 847'); transcribed as printed.
excerpt: S. Melchior Garcia Sampedro, episcopus: Patronus missionariorum et cunctorum apostolatui missionali operam dantium Archidioecesis Ovetensis, Oviedo, Spagna (3 dec. 1990, Prot. CD 847).
